Munger on rationality

"That’s why somebody like [the late Singaporean prime minister] Lee Kuan Yew was the best nationbuilder that probably ever existed in the history of the earth. His motto was: Always figure out what works and do it. Figure out what works and do it. You’re going to figure what works and do it [while] the rest of the world wants to please others or they want to do something or other. I want to be: Figure out what works and do it."
